style: schematic / diagrammatic. Pure black stage, two floating panels: a dark code-agent panel above, a simplified, chrome-free Bunny Blitz game diagram below. The game panel's ground is a dark graded night sky; flat vector game art (green platform slabs, gold coins) with the real Bunny Blitz character render as the hero. The BUNNY BLITZ banner carries the Unity mark beside it. Causal chain is the hero: type -> eval -> flight -> impact -> spawn.
font: system monospace (SF Mono/Menlo) for code, geometric sans for labels

beats.what: both panels enter together on frame 0 — agent y -44 -> 0, game y 52 -> 0, same 0.6s power3.out. Neither may start late: with immediateRender off, a late start shows the CSS-visible panel first, then blinks it out to fade in.

a glowing C# packet condenses where the code was

IMPACT: packet pops, cyan shockwave ring + flash, bunny squashes, panel recoils 9px, border flashes cyan, agent reports '✓ evaluated'
STILLNESS 0.38s — the flash decays, nothing else moves (dramatic comma)
CLIMAX: 8 coins burst from the hero and settle on the ring (back.out(1.4), stagger 0.05); gold spawn glow rises
sequenced life: the 8 coins ping one by one in spawn order (0.09s apart) — with no HUD counter, the coins alone carry the tally
the total lands: gold sweep runs the panel, agent appends '· 8 coins spawned'

content.result_line: agent panel shows '✓ evaluated' on the impact frame, then '· 8 coins spawned' once the ring has finished pinging — so the report never precedes the effect, and it is now the only place the count is stated

motion_notes: single continuous scene — no cuts, so the Seam Law/ledger does not apply; motion-doctrine's causal-motion + stillness-before-climax + no-idle-wobble rules do
banned eases avoided: no bounce.out, no elastic.out
every phase owned by a sustained-motion route: staged reveals -> animated sequence -> sequenced UI life
no seeded randomness needed; all per-index values are pure functions of the coin index
